szenen.text: Breaking: Jensen Huang is back. Nvidia reinstated him as CEO, President and board member, effective immediately.
He resigned eleven days ago. Six days ago the board chair said they did not intend to bring him back. Today: a unanimous vote.

foto.unter: Trump: Nvidia should take him back

szenen.text: Trump said Nvidia should take him back. And the board says it received input from senior levels of the US government.
Meanwhile the stock was down about fifty percent from its high, and the SEC is still examining Nvidia's accounting.
The market's answer: Nvidia since the news, {chg}.
szenen.text_ohne: The market's answer: here is Nvidia since the news.
And Bitcoin? Here is the chart since the news.

szenen.text: Our view: the White House speaks, and a week later the board obeys. In the new system, Washington picks the CEO.
